pages.text: $(item)Empty Pages$() are clean vellum awaiting a command. $(item)Symbol Pages$() are words with teeth: terrain, weather, color, sun, hunger, mercy. $(item)Lost Pages$() are sealed scraps from older hands, and they reveal themselves only when studied.

$(item)Leather$() alone in the $(thing)Book Binder$() yields a blank $(item)Descriptive Book$(). Treat it as an unwoken door. Feed it symbols one by one until its sentence resembles the world you dare to visit.

$(item)Leather$() with an $(item)Empty Page$() makes a $(item)Linking Book$(). It remembers the place where it was written. Loose symbols nearby are spared, for a return path should not devour the map that made the journey.

The blue field in the binder is no ornament. There you name the sleeping Age. The craft trims ugly marks and repeated names, not from vanity, but to keep one world's door from opening into another's bones.
